entries.en: The dancer adjusted her headdress before stepping onto the stage.
entries.zh: 舞者上台前调整了一下头饰。

entries.en: He gazed longingly at the sea from his office window.
entries.zh: 他从办公室的窗户满怀向往地望着大海。

entries.meaningZh: 没有月亮或看不见月亮的
entries.en: We followed the torchlight along the path on a moonless night.
entries.zh: 在一个看不见月亮的夜晚，我们循着手电筒的光沿小路前行。
